name: Follow the Thread — hand loom
description: A geometric loom: twelve warp threads, a four-by-four lift draft, a pickable shuttle and a reed. A complete shuttle pass through the shed can be beaten into a continuous weft. Each pick keeps the draft used when it was made.

thread_loom.name: Follow the Thread — hand loom
thread_loom.description: Take the shuttle from the lit side, carry it through the opening, then press its trigger or BEAT. PLAIN/TWILL and the lift buttons affect future passes. PASS supplies a guided desktop alternative. UNDO removes one pass; RESET clears the sample. Geometry represents interlacement; yarn tension and friction are not simulated.
